dialogues.speaker: Memorial Stone
dialogues.text: (Several rows of names of Millelith warriors are carved into the memorial, and the following is inscribed below...)

dialogues.speaker: Memorial Stone
dialogues.text: ..."With Liyue behind us, we fought bravely, warriors all — we feared death not, and not an inch did we yield."

dialogues.speaker: Memorial Stone
dialogues.text: ..."We accomplished the task Rex Lapis gave us, and we did not betray the people's hopes — let this stone be our witness."

dialogues.speaker: Memorial Stone
dialogues.text: ..."The years may erode all, yet the Millelith shall never be moved."
